mapper.insert: insert into litemall_cj_sourcing_request (cj_sourcing_id, cj_pid, product_name, product_image, product_url, remark, price, source_status, source_status_str, cj_product_id, cj_variant_sku, add_time, update_time, deleted) values (#{cjSourcingId}, #{cjPid}, #{productName}, #{productImage}, #{productUrl}, #{remark}, #{price}, #{sourceStatus}, #{sourceStatusStr}, #{cjProductId}, #{cjVariantSku}, #{addTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
